secondary.title: Pythagoras: His Life and Teachings
secondary.author: Manfred Ullmann
secondary.rationale: An early, yet still relevant, scholarly examination of Pythagoras's life and the philosophical and religious aspects of Pythagoreanism.

suggestions.notes: Direct primary sources authored by Pythagoras himself are extremely scarce and largely lost. Most surviving texts are attributed to later Pythagoreans or are collections compiled centuries after his death. Therefore, the primary source section is empty, and the focus is on secondary scholarly analysis of the available evidence.
